articles.title: Silvergate ex-CEO blames Biden pressure for bank’s 2023 wind-down
articles.snippet: Alan Lane said a “coordinated attack” by the Biden administration made Silvergate’s continued operation untenable and prompted its liquidation.

articles.title: Cronos Erased Two Hours of Transactions to Reverse $111 Million DeFi Exploit
articles.snippet: The rollback reversed legitimate activity alongside the attack, while $9.19 million remains unrecovered, according to Cronos.
